'''[[Dame Anna]]''' is one of the ten {{Card|Knights}} from {{Set|Dark Ages}}. Like other [[Knight]]s, this card is an [[Action]]-[[Attack]]-[[Knight]] that performs a [[trashing attack]] against opponents. This card's unique ability allows you to [[trash]] up to 2 cards from your hand, making it particularly valuable when no other trashing is available in the [[Kingdom]].
